bio: What makes this deluxe bistro in Hamburg's bustling Schanzenviertel so beloved? A perfect blend of cuisine, service and atmosphere. Once a dance hall, this place now exudes a laid-back yet lively energy, and feels at once trendy and chic with its decorative wine racks – the white marble counter in the middle of the space is a striking feature. The delicious contemporary food incorporates regional, seasonal, and international influences. Order à la carte or compile your own four-course Your Choice set menu, with a fish, a meat or vegetarian option for the main course. Wiener schnitzel is also always available on Sundays. The impressive wine list comprises over 500 items, and the staff provide expert guidance. Alternatively, you could have a cocktail. Lovely pavement terrace....
